content.text:
This is our interpretation of your question:

Group revenue in INR by business this year

content.statement:
WITH __pnl AS (
  SELECT
    business,
    fiscal_year,
    group_line,
    row_type,
    amount_inr
  FROM WIPRO_FINANCE_360_APP.APP_DATA.V_AGENT_PNL
)
SELECT
  business,
  SUM(IFF(group_line = 'REVENUE', amount_inr, 0)) AS revenue_inr
FROM __pnl
WHERE
  fiscal_year = 2026 AND row_type = 'ENTITY'
GROUP BY
  business
ORDER BY
  revenue_inr DESC
 -- Generated by Cortex Analyst (request_id: a0e7ea71-bb25-449a-a97e-6106d4afe499)
;
